description:
calibre is the one stop solution to all your e-book needs.

calibre is an e-book manager. It can view, convert, edit and catalog e-books in all of the major e-book formats. It can also talk to e-book reader devices. It can go out to the internet and fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS.
Bug fixes
- PDF Output: Fix a regression in calibre 9 which caused links in PDF to scroll to a target location minus the top margin, thus ending up a few lines above the target
- Content server: Fix an error when uploading a data file to a book with no existing data files
  Closes tickets: 2162628
- Content server: Fix a regression in the previous release that broke searching in the builtin viewer
  Closes tickets: 2162644
- Content server: Fix a regression in the previous release that caused the conversion options sections to be missing
  Closes tickets: 2162647
- Book details panel: Fix a regression in the previous release that broke drag and drop of covers
  Closes tickets: 2162711
- Windows: Fix a crash caused by some third party plugins trying to send notifications in non-GUI threads
  Closes tickets: 2162935
- Bulk metadata dialog: Fix a regression in the previous release that caused the yes/no buttons to be hidden for Yes/No column edit controls
  Closes tickets: 2162638
- Edit book: Compress Images: Fix error when converting GIF to JPEG on Windows
- Linux: Preload html5-parser to avoid errors on systems that ship ancient libxml2 when converting to PDF
Improved news sources
- Nautilus Magazine
